title: Collapse three copies of the same summary walk
task:
`src/domain/summary.mjs` implements the same count-and-percentage walk three times, once per entry point.

Collapse the duplication behind a single implementation while keeping `overallSummary`, `prioritySummary` and `filteredSummary` exported with their current signatures and their current return values — including the empty-list case, which returns zero percent rather than NaN.

This is a behaviour-preserving change: `test/summary.test.mjs` must pass untouched, and no other module may change.
